findings.title: Thermometers are provided and accurate.
findings.comment: Inspector observed no ambient thermometers in the cold holding units (walk in cooler and prep coolers) at the facility. Ambient thermometers should be placed toward the warmest part of the cooling unit to ensure temperature control for food safety (TCS) food items are cold held at or below 41F. Obtain and place ambient thermometers by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 4-204.112(B) Temperature Measuring Devices. (B) Except as specified in (C) of this section, cold or hot holding EQUIPMENT used for TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. [C]

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment: No sanitizer solution was prepared in the cafe area. Inspector also noticed the sanitizer concentrate bag at the wall-mounted dispenser was nearly empty. PIC changed the concentrate bag and prepared sanitizer solution upon request. Sanitizer was observed at 400ppm quat. Ensure sanitizer is prepared prior to engaging in any food prep.
findings.citation_text: 4-303.11 (B) Except for those that are generated on-site at the time of use, chemical SANITIZERS that are used to sanitize EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-7, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation. [C]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114 Spray bottle of sanitizer in the pizza prep area was at 0ppm quat. Another spray bottle prepared earlier in the day was observed at 200ppm. Spray bottle at 0ppm was discarded and replaced with fresh solution at 200ppm.
A quaternary ammonia compound solution shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions and be maintained at the concentration as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling. Use test strips to verify concentration. Ensure all spray bottles of sanitizer are checked with test strips to verify concentration and refreshed as needed prior to concentration becoming weak and ineffective.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.citation_text:
2-301.14  Food employees were observed putting on gloves and going between glove changes without first washing hands. Proper handwashing and glove use were discussed. Employees were observed washing hands between tasks and glove changes for the remainder of the inspection.
Food Employees shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms immediately before engaging in food preparation including working with exposed food, clean equipment and utensils, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. Hands must also be washed before putting on gloves/between glove changes and after engaging in other activities that contaminate the hands.

findings.title: No bare hand contact with RTE food or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed
findings.citation_text:
3-301.11 Employee was observed slicing pizza without wearing gloves. Company policy is to wear gloves during all food handling. Glove use was discussed, and gloves were worn for all food handling the remainder of the inspection.
Except when washing fruits and vegetables or when ingredients will be added to food that is being fully cooked/has a kill step for pathogens, food employees may not contact exposed, ready-to-eat food with their bare hands and shall use suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, single-use gloves, or dispensing equipment.

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.comment:
4-204-112 Thermometer could not be located in at least one of the prep coolers. Ensure that all cold holding units used for storage of TCS foods have a functioning thermometer for monitoring the temperature. 
Cold or hot holding equipment used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display.
